This legal and technical framework was intentionally constructed to repress the natural ability of individuals to circumvent controls that companies place on digital media.", "summary": "The DMCA and associated hardware restrictions were designed to make it harder for users to break digital handcuffs, effectively stopping them from sharing copies."}, "17": {"original": "The DMCA's goal is to stop people from sharing, which is an attack on society.", "rephrased": "The primary objective of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) is to stop people from sharing copies of published works, a goal that constitutes a fundamental attack on society. By designing laws specifically intended to halt the sharing of information, this legislation undermines the social fabric and infringes upon the public's right to access and distribute knowledge.", "summary": "The DMCA's goal is to stop people from sharing, which is an attack on society."}, "18": {"original": "DRM increases control by large companies by forcing everyone to follow the same", "rephrased": "Digital Rights Management (DRM) systems increase the control exerted by large corporations by forcing everyone to follow the same restrictive technical standard. This consolidation of diverse practices into a single, uniform system allows a select few companies to dominate the market and restrict user freedom, rather than fostering a competitive environment where users have choices.", "summary": "DRM increases control by large companies by forcing everyone to follow the same restrictive standard."}, "19": {"original": "Competition between diverse systems would allow people to bypass DRM, but a con", "rephrased": "Competition between diverse systems would naturally allow people to bypass Digital Rights Management (DRM), but a coordinated conspiracy forces uniformity across the industry. Instead of a healthy market with varied options, publishers align on a single restrictive standard, eliminating the competition that would otherwise enable users to find ways to access content without these oppressive controls.", "summary": "Competition between diverse systems would allow people to bypass DRM, but a conspiracy forces uniformity."}}
